What_can_be_written: Sample-level descriptive differences in selected nine-node conditional-association networks.
What_must_not_be_written: Individual change, causality, population-design inference, measurement invariance, or constraint equivalence.

What_can_be_written: Within-wave edge-weight uncertainty and diagnostic limits.
What_must_not_be_written: Bootstrap interval crossing zero as a second edge-selection rule.

What_can_be_written: Cautious within-wave Expected Influence and auxiliary Strength descriptions.
What_must_not_be_written: Cross-wave significance, causal importance, salience or intervention priority.

What_can_be_written: Edges and relational configurations within each pre-specified education group and wave.
What_must_not_be_written: Statistically significant education-group differences or education as elite/sophistication.

What_can_be_written: Whether descriptive patterns persist under pre-specified alternative specifications.
What_must_not_be_written: Sensitivity result as post-hoc selection of the most favourable specification.

What_can_be_written: Whether direction/retention claims meet the pre-specified reproducibility rule.
What_must_not_be_written: ROBUST/MIXED/NOT_ROBUST as a p-value, significance, or equivalence result.

What_can_be_written: Use only manifested figures/tables with the required caption boundaries.
What_must_not_be_written: Unqualified figure captions or invisible scale/layout changes.

What_can_be_written: A researcher with authorised ANES access can trace code, inputs, versions, seeds and outputs.
What_must_not_be_written: A claim that raw ANES data are redistributed with the archive.

What_can_be_written: Current researcher-selected title and RQs may guide drafting but remain to be entered in the formal decision log.
What_must_not_be_written: A claim that supervisor confirmation has already been obtained.
